customer_name: The State University of New York (SUNY)
business_problem: Now, researchers can skip the technical complexity, giving them more time to focus on what they do best—finding solutions to the world’s biggest problems.
solution_summary: Now, researchers can skip the technical complexity, giving them more time to focus on what they do best—finding solutions to the world’s biggest problems. They can reach the Gemini platform, reserve compute engines using processing power from Google’s AI Hypercomputer , and access over 200 models in the Model Garden , providing integrated infrastructure to speed the time to science. Key components include AI Hypercomputer runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads; Gemini platform coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application; Compute Engine runs serverless or virtualized application services with elastic scale for production AI workloads. Reported outcomes include 70% of researchers strengthened their positions for grants and proposals; 67% achieved significant time savings and research acceleration; 60% successfully completed a major component of their core research.
